title: Welcome to Tiny Siege
label: 01 / YOUR MISSION
speech: Welcome to Tiny Siege. You and a friend build fortresses and choose secret orders. Your mission is simple: destroy the opponent's crown marked command room while keeping your own standing.

title: Build a better bad idea
label: 02 / CONSTRUCTION
tip: Choose Build → pick a piece → place up to three blocks.
speech: Choose Build, select a piece, then click empty cells on your fortress. You can place up to three pieces per round. Click a planned piece again to undo it. Every piece needs a connected path to the ground.

title: Know when to defend
label: 03 / REINFORCEMENT
speech: Expecting a shot? Choose Reinforce and select up to three friendly blocks, including your command room. Each costs two supplies, repairs six health, and shields four damage this round. Defenses happen before incoming fire.

title: Choose your argument
label: 04 / FOUR WEAPONS
tip: Cannon screens • Drill pierces • Scatter blasts • Mortar bypasses.
speech: Choose Fire and aim at the enemy. Cannon hits the first block in a row. Drill hits the first two. Scatter damages a cluster. Mortar drops on the exact cell, bypassing cover. Highlights preview the current targets, but new enemy walls can change the shot.

title: Gravity keeps the score
label: 05 / COLLAPSE
tip: No path to ground? It becomes rubble.
speech: Blocks without a connected path to the ground collapse after damage. Braces also connect diagonally, saving overhangs. Powder is cheap protection, but explodes into its four neighbors when destroyed. Falling rubble causes no extra damage.

title: Two plans. One moment.
label: 06 / SECRET ORDERS
tip: Lock your order. Both attacks resolve together.
speech: Choose one action, then lock your order. You can also hold to save supplies. Both attacks resolve together after defenses. If both command rooms fall in the same round, the match is a draw. In local play, look away during your friend's turn.

title: Invite your favorite rival
label: 07 / PLAY ONLINE
tip: Play online → Create room → Copy invite link.
speech: To play on separate devices, open Play online. Enter your name and create a room. Copy the invitation to your friend. They open it, enter their name, and join. Both players plan on their own screens. The server keeps orders secret until both are locked.

title: Keep the grudge going
label: 08 / SUPPLIES & REMATCH
tip: Both choose Next round. Both choose rematch. Play again.
speech: Start with ten supplies and earn four each round. Mints earn extra income; arsenals boost damage. Rising pressure eventually damages both command rooms, so no siege lasts forever. Online, both players choose Next round to continue, or Settle the score for a rematch. Good luck, commander.
